plan.ownStyle: Poster look (design review R4 fix 2, sheet 3). No coloured band over a centred phone and no device edge. Each frame's top area is the app's OWN ground colour and the capture continues it, so the caption reads as part of the screen: work red on the run frames, the app's warm off-white (#F3EFF0) with near-black text on the rest. Caption in SF Pro Black (generator font 'black', the app's own numeral weight), set top-left of the screen area. Frames 1 and 5 are run screens where the numerals are the hero: full bleed, caption on the work or rest colour above the numerals.
plan.frame1: full-bleed on the new run screen; background = work red #D42A1E, white text. Recapture needed (new run screen).
plan.frame3: Caption 'each timer shows its own shape' must be true: capture data gives the templates their own interval colours (Tabata red, Boxing amber, Walk/Run green, EMOM blue, Circuit violet) and the list starts with the Tabata tile whole. If the capture cannot show different colours, change the caption to 'Tabata, EMOM, boxing: each timer drawn as its own strip.' and keep the strips.
plan.frame5: full-bleed on the rest screen; background = the rest colour sampled from the capture's top-left pixel (set it in frame style, text colour chosen for 4.5:1).
plan.frame6: Android capture still shows two 'Ended early' rows and 'Workouts: 2 / 00:48': recapture with scripts/store-history-seed.sql applied (as on iOS).
plan.frame8: Android capture lists emulator voice ids (en-us-x-iob-local): recapture with voice cues off so the picker is hidden (as on iOS). Also show the privacy paragraph rather than a toggle list (review fix 6).
plan.frame7: Fill the lower 40 % (longer pasted timer with its strip) or crop to the card.
plan.video: The preview video must END on the done screen of a COMPLETED workout (use a short Quick test that runs to its end, not End workout), not on the End dialog; silent unless the owner OKs recorded beeps.
